Metadata.Title: Dark Souls Remastered
Metadata.Name: Motion Blur Off
Metadata.Note: Turns off the camera motion blur. Sets the renderer's camera blur switch to off and its blur strength to 0, so it also works with PS4 Pro checkerboard rendering.
Metadata.Author: Hobbergib

Metadata.Title: Dark Souls Remastered
Metadata.Name: Depth of Field Off
Metadata.Note: Removes the distance/near depth of field blur. Forces the far and near DoF strength from the area lighting params to 0, the same as areas that have no DoF.
Metadata.Author: Hobbergib

Metadata.Title: Dark Souls Remastered
Metadata.Name: Player Lantern Off
Metadata.Note: Removes the light the remaster adds around the player, for darker original-style lighting. Sets the LocalPlayerLantern point light intensity multiplier from 1.6 to 0.
Metadata.Author: Hobbergib
